limitations: Summed Electron working sets may count shared pages repeatedly and measure neither unique resident memory nor VRAM.
This 90-second exploratory probe cannot establish long-term leak freedom, thermal stability, power use or production memory acceptance.
A fresh dedicated profile and zero screenshots/recording remove earlier capture retention from this process; desktop load and Chromium allocation/cache changes remain uncontrolled.
Phase draw counts include entry, scene retarget and reconciliation submissions; they are separate from warmed steady-state Quiet/minimize samples in the full verifier.
The recorded 0x0 contentBounds were read after the final minimized phase, not during visible work; this receipt does not establish visible viewport dimensions.
Callbacks, scene submissions and process CPU are not presented-frame timing or physical input latency.
Private machine paths, process/window identifiers and raw logs are omitted; source/build hashes and measured sample values are retained.

summary.meaning: Observed shared-page-counting process working-set sum across 95 samples; not unique resident memory, a memory budget or a leak-free conclusion.
